pages.quiz:
COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Logic Gates.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Gates.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Gates.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.

4. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

5. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Relational Database Fundamentals.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

7. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

8. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Object Oriented Programming Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relational Database Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Structured Query Language and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

2. C — CPU

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.

6. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.

11. D — Information and Communication Technology

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
